values.note: '$45 nightly all utilities included'; weekly $280; monthly $550 plus metered power ($0.15/kWh, $75 deposit), 2 people. Campspot, read 2026-10-22, one night 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-14, 2 adults: every hookup site type $47 average, i.e. the $45 site plus the park's $2 booking fee once per stay (2026-10-13 breakdown); a no-hookup 'Boondocking RV site' $42. Daily/weekly rates cover 4 people; $5 a night per extra person, 6 maximum.

values.note: 'All sites must be reserved and/or paid online ... in advance' (the site's 'Online Booking' button goes to Campspot), and 'All reservations require contact by phone prior to check in.' Stays over a month by phone. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out 11 a.m. Cancel 14+ days ahead for a refund less $25. Campspot offered nothing for April 2027 dates on 2026-10-22.

booking.source: https://www.yatesrvresortcampground.com/park-rules (reservation, check-in and cancellation lines) + https://www.yatesrvresortcampground.com ('Online Booking' -> https://www.campspot.com/book/yatesrvresort), read 2026-10-22

note: Small RV park on the owners' 22-acre property in Forest City, opened 2021: gravel pads with cement patios, a fenced dog area, nature trail. Gas, food and a laundromat nearby. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $45 a night (operator's pricing page; Campspot $47 = $45 + $2 booking fee) and 50-amp full hookups, Campspot booking; added site dimensions (max 45 ft, pull-through), no dump/laundry/bathhouse (self-contained only), free Wi-Fi. Note: corrected the site size (the operator gives 35 ft wide x 65 ft deep, not 35 x 50). Not stated: site count (10, derived, left), season (year-round, derived, left).
flags: RV age/condition rule: 'All RVs MUST be modern or like new less than 15 years old in good functional condition with NO exterior damage or paint defects', exceptions 'UPON APPROVAL by submitting pictures' (https://www.yatesrvresortcampground.com/park-rules). Check against EKKO's model year.

Long-stay character: monthly rates and a page aimed at those 'traveling or working close by', but 'WE DO NOT HAVE PERMANENT RESIDENTS' and every hookup site type sells nightly on Campspot; passes the tests as far as the pages show.
